prompt:
Create a square waist-up profile illustration of ONE rugged human man of Bree, equipped to protect himself on rough streets and wilderness roads. Use the latest attached book illustration as STYLE and clothing reference only, not its group composition. Warm brown fine pencil/pen contours, medium-density directional hatching and crosshatching, darkest brown pockets in overlapping cloth, broad pale cream paper highlights. This is the established approved illustrated portrait style, neither photographic graphite realism nor sparse outline cartoon.
A stocky powerful working traveler in his late thirties or forties, weather-beaten angular face, broad jaw, slightly crooked nose, small healed eyebrow scar, short rough beard, untidy medium-length hair beneath a plain soft travelling cap. Alert guarded eyes and firm closed mouth, tough but humane. Thick practical medieval belted tunic with a modest quilted protective layer, worn leather shoulder strap, heavy wool travelling mantle draped back enough to reveal his gear, leather wrist bracers. A plain sturdy sheathed arming sword at his hip with one hand resting naturally on its pommel, small utilitarian belt pouch. No ornate armor, no modern suit lapels, no necktie, no gentleman's waistcoat, no cheerful innkeeper pose. Head and upper body readable in three-quarter view; include belt and sword hilt in lower portion of square, head with ample margin for avatar cropping.
Moderately stylized anatomical drawing, expressive face made with selective lines and visible short brown hatch strokes. Hair and beard rendered as locks and small hatched shapes with cream gaps, clothing folds following form. Muted reddish umber ink/pencil on very pale ivory paper; subtle sketch hatching immediately behind shoulders fades to blank background. No landscape, lettering, frame, watermark, color fill, smooth shaded photorealism, pores or thick cartoon lines. One single character. Intended 640x640 WebP profile image.
